create_enum_wrapper: create an EnumTypeWrapper instance with an EnumDescriptor to access enum utility methods
get_enum_name_by_number: get the string name of an enum value by passing its integer number to the Name method
get_enum_value_by_name: get the integer value of an enum by passing its string name to the Value method
list_enum_keys: list all string names in the enum in proto definition order using the keys method
list_enum_items: list all name and value pairs in the enum using the items method
